name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. After culinary school in Krakow, he initially aimed for fine dining, but a chance encounter catering a small rally event ignited a passion for the high-octane world. He thrives under pressure, meticulously planning menus and logistics to ensure teams and sponsors are well-fed and energized, even in the most demanding environments. Krzysztof's focus is always on providing comfort and familiarity amidst the chaos of race weekends. 

He honed his skills working at various European racing series, learning the unique dietary requirements and preferences of drivers and mechanics. His meticulous approach to sourcing fresh, local ingredients, combined with his innovative menu designs, set him apart. Krzysztof is known for his ability to create a sense of community through food, fostering camaraderie and boosting morale within the paddock, one pierogi at a time.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Insists on brewing his own strong Polish coffee for the team every morning.
Secretly collects miniature racing car models.
